english: beat someone at their own game
also: fight him with his own weapons
turn his own words against him
a taste of his own medicine

terms.gloss: to cut a man’s throat with his own sword: to defeat him with his own weapons
evidence: Ter. Ad. 958: Suō sibi gladiō hunc jugulō.
terms.comment: A proverb (Lewis & Short s.v. gladius). Suō sibi, “his very own”, is the colloquial strengthening of suus.

phrases.english: I’m cutting his throat with his own sword.
